design.purpose: A weatherproof-looking outdoor planter for herbs or flowers for one gardener; interior is about 36 × 14 cm with 20 cm planting depth before soil is added. Confirm all board dimensions before cutting because the photo sizes are estimates.

steps.c: Place the wide board flat for measuring and cutting
Mark and crosscut front, back and both 14 cm ends
Place the second board flat for the base cut
Crosscut the 40 cm base, keeping the long offcut
Sand cut edges and faces of all five box parts
Place the 40 cm base flat on the work surface
Stand the front side on the base front edge
Stand the back side on the base back edge
Fit the left end between front and back at the start
Fit the right end between front and back at the end
Drive screws through front into the left end
Drive screws through front into the right end
Drive screws through back into the left end
Drive screws through back into the right end
Drive screws up through base into front and back
Drive screws up through base into both ends
Drill two drainage holes through the base
